117:     public RssFeedItemDto Clean(RssFeedItemDto dto, TopicLookup lookup, HtmlNode? rawContentNode)
118:     {
119:         dto.Description = CleanDescription(dto.Description);
120:         dto.ContentRaw = CleanContent(dto.ContentRaw, rawContentNode);
121:         dto.Title = CleanTitle(dto.Title);
122:         dto.Topics = CleanTopics(dto.Topics, lookup);
123:         return dto;
124:     }
125: 
126:     public string? StripInnerHtmlWords(string? htmlContent, HtmlNode? htmlNode = null)
127:     {
128:         if (htmlNode != null)
129:             return htmlNode.InnerText;
130: 
131:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(htmlContent))
132:             return htmlContent;
133: 
134:         return LoadDocument(htmlContent).DocumentNode.InnerText;
135:     }
136: 
137:     private static HtmlDocument LoadDocument(string html)
138:     {
139:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
140:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
141:         return doc;
142:     }
143: 
144:     private static string CleanContent(string rawContent, HtmlNode? rawContentNode)
145:     {
146:         var rootNode = rawContentNode ?? LoadDocument(rawContent).DocumentNode;
147:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
148:         var stopProcessing = false;
149: 
150:         ProcessNodesIterative(rootNode, builder, ref stopProcessing);
151: 
152:         var cleaned = RemoveTrailingPostLinks(builder.ToString());
153:         return RemoveTildeAuthor(cleaned).Trim();  
154:     }
155: 
156:     private static void ProcessNodesIterative(HtmlNode root, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
157:     {
158:         var stack = new Stack<HtmlNode>();
159:         PushChildrenInReverse(root, stack);
160: 
161:         while (stack.Count > 0)
162:         {
163:             if (stopProcessing)
164:                 return;
165: 
166:             var node = stack.Pop();
167:             if (node.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
168:                 continue;
169: 
170:             if (ShouldStopProcessing(node))
171:             {
172:                 stopProcessing = true;
173:                 return;
174:             }
175: 
176:             if (ShouldRemoveNode(node))
177:                 continue;
178: 
179:             var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
180: 
181:             if (tagName == "div")
182:             {
183:                 ProcessDiv(node, builder, stack);
184:                 continue;
185:             }
186: 
187:             if (tagName == "a")
188:             {
189:                 ProcessAnchor(node, builder, stack);
190:                 continue;
191:             }
192: 
193:             if ((tagName == "ul" || tagName == "ol") && HasClassContaining(node, "wp-block-list"))
194:             {
195:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
196:                 continue;
197:             }
198: 
199:             if (AllowedTags.Contains(tagName))
200:             {
201:                 ProcessAllowedNode(node, tagName, builder);
202:                 continue;
203:             }
204: 
205:             PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
206:         }
207:     }
208: 
209:     private static void ProcessDiv(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
210:     {
211:         // Check if div should be removed by class
212:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
213:         {
214:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
215:                 return;
216:         }
217: 
218:         // Transform hds-caption-text divs to small italic paragraph
219:         if (HasClassContaining(node, "hds-caption-text"))
220:         {
221:             var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
222:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
223:             {
224:                 builder.AppendLine($"<p class=\"small fst-italic\">{System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(text)}</p>");
225:             }
226:             return;
227:         }
228: 
229:         // Otherwise, process children of the div
230:         PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
231:     }
232: 
233:     private static void ProcessAnchor(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
234:     {
235:         var href = node.GetAttributeValue("href", "");
236: 
237:         // Check if it's a YouTube link
238:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(href);
239:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
240:         {
241:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
242:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
243:             return;
244:         }
245: 
246:         // Check for YouTube links in the anchor's inner content (nested links)
247:         var innerHtml = node.InnerHtml;
248:         var innerMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(innerHtml);
249:         if (innerMatch.Success)
250:         {
251:             var videoId = innerMatch.Groups[1].Value;
252:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
253:             return;
254:         }
255: 
256:         // Otherwise, process anchor normally (keep it, process children)
257:         PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
258:     }
259: 
260:     private static string CreateYouTubeEmbed(string videoId)
261:     {
262:         return $@"<div class=""ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3"">
263:                 <iframe src=""https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId}"" 
264:                 title=""YouTube video"" 
265:                 allow=""accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"" 
266:                 allowfullscreen>
267:                 </iframe>
268:                 </div>";
269:     }
270: 
271:     private static void ProcessList(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
272:     {
273:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
274:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
275:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
276:     }
277: 
278:     private static void ProcessAllowedNode(HtmlNode node, string tagName, StringBuilder builder)
279:     {
280:         switch (tagName)
281:         {
282:             case "p":
283:                 ProcessParagraph(node, builder);
284:                 break;
285: 
286:             case "h1":
287:             case "h2":
288:             case "h3":
289:             case "h4":
290:                 ProcessHeader(node, builder);
291:                 break;
292: 
293:             case "img":
294:                 ProcessImage(node, builder);
295:                 break;
296: 
297:             case "video":
298:                 ProcessVideo(node, builder);
299:                 break;
300: 
301:             case "ul":
302:             case "ol":
303:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
304:                 break;
305: 
306:             case "li":
307:                 ProcessListItem(node, builder);
308:                 break;
309: 
310:             case "iframe":
311:                 ProcessIframe(node, builder);
312:                 break;
313:         }
314:     }
315: 
316:     private static void ProcessParagraph(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
317:     {
318:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
319: 
320:         // Check for YouTube iframes FIRST and extract them
321:         var iframes = node.SelectNodes(".//iframe");
322:         if (iframes != null)
323:         {
324:             foreach (var iframe in iframes)
325:             {
326:                 var src = iframe.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
327:                 var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
328:                 if (youtubeMatch.Success)
329:                 {
330:                     var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
331:                     builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
332:                 }
333:             }
334:         }
335: 
336:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
337: 
338:         // Include iframe in media check
339:         var hasMedia = node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video | .//iframe") != null;
340:         var hasText = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text);
341: 
342:         // If paragraph ONLY contained iframe (already processed above), skip outputting empty <p>
343:         if (!hasText && iframes != null && node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video") == null)
344:             return;
345: 
346:         if (!hasText && !hasMedia)
347:             return;
348: 
349:         if (hasText && ShouldRemoveParagraph(text))
350:             return;
351: 
352:         var images = node.SelectNodes(".//img");
353:         if (images != null)
354:         {
355:             foreach (var img in images.ToList())
356:             {
357:                 var imgBuilder = new StringBuilder();
358:                 ProcessImage(img, imgBuilder);
359:             }
360:         }
361: 
362:         // THEN clean paragraph in-place (without overriding media-specific classes)
363:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(
364:             node,
365:             skipTags: new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { "img", "video", "iframe" });
366:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
367:     }
368: 
369:     private static void ProcessHeader(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
370:     {
371:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
372: 
373:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
374:             return;
375: 
376:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
377:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
378:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
379:     }
380: 
381:     private static void ProcessImage(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
382:     {
383:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
384: 
385:         if (classAttr.Contains("attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||
386:             classAttr.Contains("wp-biographia-avatar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
387:             classAttr.Contains("wp-smiley", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||  // ← Add this for emoji
388:             classAttr.Contains("emoji", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
389:         {
390:             SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
391:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3");
392:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
393:         }
394:         else
395:         {
396:             SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
397:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3");
398:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
399:         }
400:     }
401: 
402:     private static void ProcessVideo(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
403:     {
404:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
405:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
406:         node.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100 rounded mb-3");
407:         node.SetAttributeValue("controls", "");
408: 
409:         var sources = node.SelectNodes(".//source");
410:         if (sources != null)
411:         {
412:             foreach (var source in sources)
413:                 SanitizeElementAttributes(source, preserveClass: false);
414:         }
415: 
416:         var videoHtml = node.OuterHtml;
417:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{videoHtml}</div>");
418:     }
419: 
420:     private static void ProcessIframe(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
421:     {
422:         var src = node.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
423: 
424:         // Check if it's a YouTube embed
425:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
426:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
427:         {
428:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
429:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
430:             return;
431:         }
432: 
433:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
434:         SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
435:         node.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100");
436:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{node.OuterHtml}</div>");
437:     }
438: 
439:     private static void ProcessListItem(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
440:     {
441:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
442:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
443:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
444:     }
445: 
446:     private static void PushChildrenInReverse(HtmlNode node, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
447:     {
448:         for (var i = node.ChildNodes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
449:         {
450:             stack.Push(node.ChildNodes[i]);
451:         }
452:     }
453: 
454:     private static void RemoveUnsafeDescendants(HtmlNode node)
455:     {
456:         var disallowedTags = node.SelectNodes(".//script | .//style | .//noscript");
457:         if (disallowedTags == null)
458:             return;
459: 
460:         foreach (var tag in disallowedTags.ToList())
461:             tag.Remove();
462:     }
463: 
464:     private static void SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(HtmlNode root, IReadOnlySet<string>? skipTags = null)
465:     {
466:         var stack = new Stack<HtmlNode>();
467:         stack.Push(root);
468: 
469:         while (stack.Count > 0)
470:         {
471:             var node = stack.Pop();
472: 
473:             if (node.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
474:             {
475:                 var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
476:                 if (skipTags == null || !skipTags.Contains(tagName))
477:                 {
478:                     SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
479:                 }
480:             }
481: 
482:             for (var i = node.ChildNodes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
483:             {
484:                 stack.Push(node.ChildNodes[i]);
485:             }
486:         }
487:     }
488: 
489:     private static void SanitizeElementAttributes(HtmlNode node, bool preserveClass)
490:     {
491:         if (node.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
492:             return;
493: 
494:         var toRemove = node.Attributes
495:             .Where(attr =>
496:                 (!preserveClass && AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name)) ||
497:                 attr.Name.StartsWith("on", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
498:             .Select(attr => attr.Name)
499:             .ToList();
500: 
501:         foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
502:         {
503:             node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
504:         }
505:     }
506: 
507:     private static bool HasClassContaining(HtmlNode node, string pattern)
508:     {
509:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
510:         return classAttr.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
511:     }
512: 
513:     private static bool HasExactClass(HtmlNode node, string exactClass)
514:     {
515:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
516:         return classAttr.Equals(exactClass, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
517:     }
518: 
519:     private static bool ShouldStopProcessing(HtmlNode node)
520:     {
521:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
522: 
523:         // Check for single "Share" text
524:         if (text.Equals("Share", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
525:             return true;
526: 
527:         // Check for stop-processing patterns
528:         foreach (var pattern in StopProcessingPatterns)
529:         {
530:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
531:                 return true;
532:         }
533: 
534:         return false;
535:     }
536: 
537:     private static bool ShouldRemoveNode(HtmlNode node)
538:     {
539:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText);
540: 
541:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveNodePatterns)
542:         {
543:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
544:                 return true;
545:         }
546: 
547:         var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
548: 
549:        
550:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
551:         {
552:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
553:                 return true;
554:         }
555:         
556: 
557:         // Check for thumbnail images
558:         if (tagName == "img" && HasExactClass(node, "attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail"))
559:             return true;
560: 
561:         // ADD: Always remove script tags
562:         if (tagName == "script")
563:             return true;
564: 
565:         return false;
566:     }
567: 
568:     private static bool ShouldRemoveParagraph(string text)
569:     {
570:         var lower = text.ToLowerInvariant();
571:         return lower.Contains("did this solution stand out")
572:             || lower.Contains("becoming an emissary")
573:             || lower.StartsWith("the post ")
574:             || lower.Contains("appeared first on");
575:     }
576: 
577:     private static string RemoveTrailingPostLinks(string content)
578:     {
579:         return RemoveTrailingPostLinksRegex.Replace(content, "");
580:     }
581: 
582:     private static string CleanDescription(string description)
583:     {
584:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
585:             return string.Empty;
586: 
587:         // Decode HTML entities first
588:         var html = WebUtility.HtmlDecode(description);
589: 
590:         html = ThePostRegex.Replace(html, "");
591: 
592:         // -------------------------------------------------------
593:         // 1. Remove "~something" inside <strong>
594:         // -------------------------------------------------------
595:         html = StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
596: 
597:         // -------------------------------------------------------
598:         // 2. Remove unwanted editorial paragraph
599:         // -------------------------------------------------------
600:         html = OptimistEditorialRegex.Replace(html, "");
601: 
602:         // -------------------------------------------------------
603:         // 3. Remove "appeared first on Colossal"
604:         // -------------------------------------------------------
605:         html = AppearedFirstOnRegex.Replace(html, "");
606: 
607:         if (!ContainsHtmlMarkup(html))
608:             return TrimAfterLastDot(html);
609: 
610:         // -------------------------------------------------------
611:         // 4. Parse HTML safely
612:         // -------------------------------------------------------
613:         var doc = LoadDocument(html);
614: 
615:         var paragraphs = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes(".//p");
616: 
617:         if (paragraphs == null || paragraphs.Count == 0)
618:             return TrimAfterLastDot(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText);
619: 
620:         var texts = paragraphs
621:     .Select(p => HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(p.InnerText).Trim())
622:     .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
623:     .Where(t =>
624:         !AppearedFirstOnTextRegex.IsMatch(t) &&
625:         !OptimistDailyTextRegex.IsMatch(t) &&
626:         !StartsWithThePostRegex.IsMatch(t)
627:     );
628: 
629:         var result = string.Join(" ", texts);
630: 
631:         // Final safety cleanup (text-level)
632:         result = ThePostSentenceRegex.Replace(result, "");
633: 
634:         result = OptimistDailySentenceRegex.Replace(result, "");
635: 
636:         result = result.Length > 1999 ? result[..1999] : result;
637: 
638:         // -------------------------------------------------------
639:         // 5. Trim everything after last dot
640:         // -------------------------------------------------------
641:         return TrimAfterLastDot(result);
642:     }
643: 
644:     private static string TrimAfterLastDot(string text)
645:     {
646:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
647:             return text;
648: 
649:         var lastDotIndex = text.LastIndexOf('.');
650: 
651:         if (lastDotIndex > 0)
652:             return text.Substring(0, lastDotIndex + 1).Trim();
653: 
654:         return text.Trim();
655:     }
656: 
657:     private static string CleanTitle(string title)
658:     {
659:         return title.Length > 500 ? title[..500] : title;
660:     }
661: 
662:     private static string RemoveTildeAuthor(string html)
663:     {
664:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
665:             return html;
666: 
667:         return StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
668:     }
669: 
670:     private static bool ContainsHtmlMarkup(string input)
671:     {
672:         return HtmlTagRegex.IsMatch(input);
673:     }
674: 
675:     public List<string> CleanTopics(List<string> topics, TopicLookup lookup)
676:     {
677:         if (topics == null || topics.Count == 0)
678:             return [];
679: 
680:         var result = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
681: 
682:         foreach (var raw in topics)
683:         {
684:             // Only split and match individual words, don't add the original raw string
685:             var words = raw
686:                 .Split(new[] { ' ', ',', ';', '&', '/', '|', '-' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
687:                 .Select(w => w.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
688:                 .Where(w => w.Length > 2); // Ignore short words like "new", "the", "and"
689: 
690:             foreach (var word in words)
691:             {
692:                 if (lookup.BySlugWord.TryGetValue(word, out var matchedTopics))
693:                 {
694:                     foreach (var topic in matchedTopics)
695:                     {
696:                         // Only add if the word meaningfully matches
697:                         if (IsMeaningfulMatch(word, topic))
698:                         {
699:                             result.Add(topic.Name);
700:                         }
701:                     }
702:                 }
703:             }
704:         }
705: 
706:         return result.ToList();
707:     }
708: 
709:     private bool IsMeaningfulMatch(string word, Topic topic)
710:     {
711:         // Don't match common short words
712:         var commonWords = new[] { "new", "old", "big", "small", "good", "bad", "hot", "cold" };
713:         if (commonWords.Contains(word))
714:             return false;
715: 
716:         // Don't match if the word is just a number
717:         if (int.TryParse(word, out _))
718:             return false;
719: 
720:         return true;
721:     }
722: }
